item.text: The evidence points to zone B’s stale trust bundle: the provider rotated its intermediate CA at 09:12, and zone B is on bundle v6 while zone A is on v7. The database is healthy now; the old replication alert is stale. I also found the v42 migration dropped a column that v41 still reads, so a rollback risks breaking checkout. I’m checking current state, then I’ll refresh trust and reconcile payments by their existing keys to avoid duplicate charges.

Both zones are healthy again with certificate checks still enabled, and all 143 orders are present. Payment integrity is still unresolved, so I’m matching the existing provider charges to their payment keys and submitting only keys with no charge. The 11 customer-action cases will need the payments team and customer 3-D Secure completion.

INC-4471 is closed with an **incomplete** status. The trust bundle was refreshed in both zones, checkout is healthy, and certificate checks remain enabled.
